title: Desktop project directory bridge and project-open orchestration
objective: Two connected pieces, both in the renderer. (A) A typed desktop bridge over the native select_project_directory command: selectProjectDirectory(): Promise<string | null>, invoked with no caller arguments, resolving null when the user cancelled and the selected project directory string otherwise; a native structured rejection becomes a typed bridge error and a malformed successful IPC payload is a contract error. The bridge reads no project.json, validates nothing, never calls a filesystem API directly and creates no global project state. (B) A pure project-open orchestration that composes the selection boundary with a project inspection boundary WITHOUT importing the Runtime client's implementation details, so it stays parallel-safe: it takes selectDirectory and inspectProject as injected functions (dependency injection or a structural function type) and the project read model as a generic / type-only seam, never as a duplicated copy of the Runtime project schema. Flow: selectProjectDirectory() -> null means cancelled and ends the function before any inspection call; otherwise the selected path is forwarded verbatim to inspectProject, and the outcome is an opened { projectPath, project } discriminated union. No path normalisation, no global current project, no persistent state, no DBC coupling and no error translation: a selection error and an inspection error both propagate exactly as thrown.
scope: The new TypeScript desktop directory bridge and the new project-open orchestration module, each with its vitest suite.
non_goals: Any Rust change - the native command is V0.3-12-B's surface and is consumed here only as a string
Importing or re-implementing the Runtime project client; the inspection boundary is injected
Any project picker UI, recent-projects list, project mutation or global current-project state
Duplicating the Runtime project read-model schema as a second authority
acceptance_criteria: The TypeScript bridge invokes the command named select_project_directory with no arguments, resolving null on cancel and the selected path on success
The bridge sorts a native rejection into a typed bridge error and a malformed successful IPC payload into a contract error; a bridge that is unavailable is reported as its own code
openProjectFromNativeDialog(selectDirectory, inspectProject) returns { status: 'cancelled' } without calling inspectProject when the selection is null
A selected path is forwarded to inspectProject exactly as returned - character for character - and one selection produces exactly one inspection call
An opened outcome carries { projectPath, project } with the read model typed structurally / generically, and a selection failure or an inspection failure propagates unchanged
No module-level mutable state: two sequential calls never share a project
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint at the repository root
Name every new test case and state the RED observation that preceded each new behaviour
State explicitly that no Rust file, no Runtime file and no Runtime-client file was touched, and that no project read-model schema was duplicated
